---
  title: "UV TimeCourse ChIPAnno"
author: "Julianne (Yulia) Murthy"
date: "2026-06-01"
---
 
Goal: this script serves to perform ChIPAnno analysis on CUT&Tag data and RNA-Seq data as an alternative to BETA. To see if there is an association between G4 presence/lack thereof and changes in transcription

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# LOAD LIBRARIES
```{r}
library(ChIPseeker)
library(ChIPpeakAnno)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(RSQLite)
library(txdbmaker)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```


# PATHS
```{r}
# TxDb for Homo Sapiens 
txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene
transcripts(txdb)

# Prep TxDb filter for protein coding transcripts
db_conn <- dbconn(txdb)

nm_tx  <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "transcript")
nm_tx  <- nm_tx[grepl("^NM_", nm_tx$tx_name), ]
nm_tx <- nm_tx %>% rename(tx_id = X_tx_id)
nm_ids <- nm_tx$tx_id

splicings_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "splicing") %>% 
  rename(
    tx_id   = X_tx_id,
    exon_id = X_exon_id,
    cds_id  = X_cds_id
  )
genes_raw     <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "gene") %>% rename(tx_id = `X_tx_id`)
exons_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "exon") %>% rename(exon_id = X_exon_id)
cds_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "cds") %>% rename(cds_id = X_cds_id)

splicings_full <- splicings_raw %>%
  left_join(exons_raw[, c("exon_id", "exon_start", "exon_end")], by = "exon_id") %>%
  left_join(cds_raw[, c("cds_id", "cds_start", "cds_end")],     by = "cds_id")

chrominfo_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "chrominfo")
chrominfo_raw$is_circular <- as.logical(chrominfo_raw$is_circular)

nm_tx_raw <- as.data.frame(dbReadTable(db_conn, "transcript"))

# Find transcripts that have at least one CDS = protein coding
coding_tx_ids <- unique(splicings_raw$tx_id[!is.na(splicings_raw$cds_id)])

# Filter by protein coding transcripts
txdb_coding <- makeTxDb(
  transcripts = nm_tx_raw %>% filter(X_tx_id %in% coding_tx_ids) %>% rename(tx_id = X_tx_id),
  splicings   = splicings_full %>% filter(tx_id %in% coding_tx_ids),
  genes       = genes_raw     %>% filter(tx_id %in% coding_tx_ids),
  chrominfo   = chrominfo_raw[, c("chrom", "length", "is_circular")]
)

# Verify to make sure new txdb file is accurate
length(transcripts(txdb_coding))  
length(genes(txdb_coding))

# Annotation source check
columns(org.Hs.eg.db)
head(keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype = "REFSEQ"), 20)

# BED file locations on hpc
bed_dir <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_infiles/Lindsay_UV_ChIPAnno"

# Output directory 
out_dir <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_outfiles/Lindsay_UV_ChIPAnno_updated"

# input filenames - this time using peaks unique to timepoints
file_01hr <- file.path(bed_dir, "A549_01hr_minus_mock_hq.bed")
file_24hr <- file.path(bed_dir, "A549_24hr_minus_mock_hq.bed")
file_48hr <- file.path(bed_dir, "A549_48hr_minus_mock_hq.bed")

# DESEQ SIGNIFICANT results- create 
deg_01hr <- read.csv(file.path(bed_dir, "RNA_seq_01hr.csv"), row.names=1)
deg_01hr_sig <- deg_01hr[!is.na(deg_01hr$padj) & deg_01hr$padj < 0.05, ]
write.csv(deg_01hr_sig, file.path(out_dir, "DEG_sig_01hr.csv"))

deg_24hr <- read.csv(file.path(bed_dir, "RNA_seq_24hr.csv"), row.names=1)
deg_24hr_sig <- deg_24hr[!is.na(deg_24hr$padj) & deg_24hr$padj < 0.05, ]
write.csv(deg_24hr_sig, file.path(out_dir, "DEG_sig_24hr.csv"))

deg_48hr <- read.csv(file.path(bed_dir, "RNA_seq_48hr.csv"), row.names=1)
deg_48hr_sig <- deg_48hr[!is.na(deg_48hr$padj) & deg_48hr$padj < 0.05, ]
write.csv(deg_48hr_sig, file.path(out_dir, "DEG_sig_48hr.csv"))


```


# READ IN PEAK FILES
```{r}
peak01hr <- readPeakFile(file_01hr)
peak24hr <- readPeakFile(file_24hr)
peak48hr <- readPeakFile(file_48hr)

cat("01hr peaks:  ", length(peak01hr), "\n") #6361
cat("24hr peaks:", length(peak24hr), "\n") #1387
cat("48hr peaks:", length(peak48hr), "\n") #2452

```


# ANNOTATE PEAKS
## For homo sapiens we are doing 3kb for promoter
```{r}
# Extract transcripts and gene feature
annoData <- toGRanges(txdb, feature = "gene")

# 01hr ChipAnno peaks, with flanking genes added as well
peakAnno01hr <- annotatePeakInBatch(
  peak01hr,
  AnnotationData      = annoData,
  output              = "both",
  maxgap              = 3000,
  PeakLocForDistance  = "endMinusStart",
  FeatureLocForDistance = "TSS"   
)

# 24hr ChipAnno peaks, with flanking genes added as well
peakAnno24hr <- annotatePeakInBatch(
  peak24hr,
  AnnotationData      = annoData,
  output              = "both",
  maxgap              = 3000,
  PeakLocForDistance  = "endMinusStart",
  FeatureLocForDistance = "TSS"
)

# 48hr ChipAnno peaks, with flanking genes added as well
peakAnno48hr <- annotatePeakInBatch(
  peak48hr,
  AnnotationData      = annoData,
  output              = "both",
  maxgap              = 3000,
  PeakLocForDistance  = "endMinusStart",
  FeatureLocForDistance = "TSS"
)

# Add gene symbols and gene descriptions with org.Hs.eg.db
peakAnno01hr <- addGeneIDs(peakAnno01hr,
                          orgAnn   = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                          feature_id_type = "entrez_id",
                          IDs2Add  = c("symbol","genename"))

peakAnno24hr <- addGeneIDs(peakAnno24hr,
                          orgAnn   = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                          feature_id_type = "entrez_id",
                          IDs2Add  = c("symbol","genename"))

peakAnno48hr <- addGeneIDs(peakAnno48hr,
                          orgAnn   = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                          feature_id_type = "entrez_id",
                          IDs2Add  = c("symbol","genename"))



```


# EXPORT FULL ANNOTATION CSVs
```{r}
# Convert to data frames
df01hr <- as.data.frame(peakAnno01hr)  
df24hr <- as.data.frame(peakAnno24hr)
df48hr <- as.data.frame(peakAnno48hr)

# Write full annotation CSVs
write.csv(df01hr, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnno01hr_full.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(df24hr, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnno24hr_full.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(df48hr, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnno48hr_full.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)

```

# FILTER FOR PROMOTER PEAKS 
```{r}

# Bin by promoter distance categories
bin_peaks <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(abs(distancetoFeature) <= 3000) %>%
    mutate(promoter_bin = case_when(
      abs(distancetoFeature) <= 1000                                  ~ "Promoter (<=1kb)",
      abs(distancetoFeature) >  1000 & abs(distancetoFeature) <= 2000 ~ "Promoter (1-2kb)",
      abs(distancetoFeature) >  2000 & abs(distancetoFeature) <= 3000 ~ "Promoter (2-3kb)"
    ))
}

prom01hr <- bin_peaks(df01hr)
prom24hr <- bin_peaks(df24hr)
prom48hr <- bin_peaks(df48hr)

print(table(prom01hr$promoter_bin))
print(table(prom24hr$promoter_bin))
print(table(prom48hr$promoter_bin))

cat("01hr promoter peaks:  ", nrow(prom01hr), "/", nrow(df01hr), "\n") 
cat("24hr promoter peaks:", nrow(prom24hr), "/", nrow(df24hr), "\n") 
cat("48hr promoter peaks:", nrow(prom48hr), "/", nrow(df48hr), "\n") 

```


# WRITE THE PROMOTER FILTERED CSVs
```{r}
write.csv(prom01hr, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnno01hr_promoter.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(prom24hr, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnno24hr_promoter.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(prom48hr, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnno48hr_promoter.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```


# INNERJOIN SIG DEGs & PROMOTER G4s
```{r}

# Rename symbol column to match deseq
prom01hr <- prom01hr %>% rename(SYMBOL = symbol)
prom24hr <- prom24hr %>% rename(SYMBOL = symbol)
prom48hr <- prom48hr %>% rename(SYMBOL = symbol)

# Flag whether the matched gene was nearest TSS or flanking
prom01hr <- prom01hr %>%
  group_by(peak) %>%
  mutate(association_type = ifelse(abs(distancetoFeature) == min(abs(distancetoFeature)),
                                   "nearest_TSS", "flanking")) %>%
  ungroup()
print(table(prom01hr$association_type))

prom24hr <- prom24hr %>%
  group_by(peak) %>%
  mutate(association_type = ifelse(abs(distancetoFeature) == min(abs(distancetoFeature)),
                                   "nearest_TSS", "flanking")) %>%
  ungroup()
print(table(prom24hr$association_type))

prom48hr <- prom48hr %>%
  group_by(peak) %>%
  mutate(association_type = ifelse(abs(distancetoFeature) == min(abs(distancetoFeature)),
                                   "nearest_TSS", "flanking")) %>%
  ungroup()
print(table(prom48hr$association_type))

# Use inner_join() function to match G4 peaks within 3kb of the TSS (“promoter” G4s) to differentially expressed gene
G4_DEG_01hr <- inner_join(prom01hr, deg_01hr_sig, by = "SYMBOL")
G4_DEG_24hr <- inner_join(prom24hr, deg_24hr_sig, by = "SYMBOL")
G4_DEG_48hr <- inner_join(prom48hr, deg_48hr_sig, by = "SYMBOL")

# Check how many genes overlapped
cat("01hr promoter G4s with DE genes:", nrow(G4_DEG_01hr), "\n") # 288
cat("24hr promoter G4s with DE genes:", nrow(G4_DEG_24hr), "\n")  # 36
cat("48hr promoter G4s with DE genes:", nrow(G4_DEG_48hr), "\n")  # 19

# Export to CSV
write.csv(G4_DEG_01hr, file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_01hr.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(G4_DEG_24hr, file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_24hr.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(G4_DEG_48hr, file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_48hr.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


write.table(
  G4_DEG_01hr, 
  file = file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_01hr.tsv"), 
  sep = "\t", 
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.table(
  G4_DEG_24hr, 
  file = file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_24hr.tsv"), 
  sep = "\t", 
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.table(
  G4_DEG_48hr, 
  file = file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_48hr.tsv"), 
  sep = "\t", 
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
